narratives.narrative: The simulator models a loss of availability zone eu-west-1a, which takes out the public subnet aws_subnet.public_a. This directly affects two downstream components: the load balancer aws_lb.payments and the NAT gateway aws_nat_gateway.nat_a, both marked as tier‑1 critical workloads. Detectability is high because the failure is explicitly modeled. Impact is assessed as two components affected. Likelihood and recoverability (failover path existence and RPO feasibility) are not assessable from the structural analysis alone, as no frequency/probability data or per‑resource RTO/RPO findings are provided.

The finding assesses AZ loss of eu-west-1a data subnet (aws_subnet.data_a). Detectability is high because the simulator models the failure directly. Impact is assessed as 4 components in blast radius with workload criticality tier1. Likelihood is not assessable due to lack of frequency/probability data. Recoverability (failover_path_exists and rpo_feasible) is not assessable at zone-kill level; it is evaluated per affected resource.

The NAT gateway redundancy check is assessed as satisfied; detectability is high because the simulator models the failure directly. Impact and likelihood are not assessable per the compliance check, and recoverability (failover path existence and RPO feasibility) is also not assessable.
